Here, in some superstores you have to do shelf work, and where you have to also put bottles of wines and beer in the shelf. My question is, is it Halal to do that shelf work? Please reply as soon as possible! JazakAllah. Question: Assalamualaikum, Hadhrat I like to confirm I am in student visa in UK. Here, in some superstores you have to do shelf work, and where you have to also put bottles of wines and beer in the shelf. My question is, is it Halal to do that shelf work? Please reply as soon as possible! JazakAllah. Answer ID: 22242 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 753/753/M=1431) The job of putting bottles of wine in shelves is makrooh according to Hadhrat Imam Abu Yusuf and Hadhrat Imam Muhammad ( رحمهم الله ) due to help in sin . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
